# Quality Checklist: Layered Extension Testing

**Purpose**: Validate whether the feature requirements are complete, clear, consistent, measurable, and ready for implementation review
**Created**: 2026-04-01
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/spec checklist` command based on feature context and requirement quality goals.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are maintainer-facing goals defined clearly for all three test layers without relying on plan-only context? [Completeness, Spec §Feature Summary; Spec §User Scenarios & Testing]
- [ ] CHK002 Are explicit boundaries documented so this feature cannot be misread as adding new grouped-prompt product behavior rather than test coverage? [Completeness, Spec §Explicit Non-Goals]
- [ ] CHK003 Are documentation and workflow update requirements complete for every affected artifact (`README.md`, `AGENTS.md`, `lefthook.yml`, `package.json`)? [Completeness, Spec §CC-003; Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK004 Are dependency-assumption requirements complete for Layer 3, including what to do if the `@marcfargas/pi-test-harness` contract differs from expectations? [Completeness, Spec §Assumptions]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK005 Is “meaningful coverage across all three categories” translated into concrete scope statements that a reviewer can assess without inferring missing layers? [Clarity, Spec §Feature Summary; Spec §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK006 Are the repo-specific workflow obligations around `bun run test` and pre-push enforcement stated clearly enough to avoid confusion with pre-commit behavior? [Clarity, Spec §Clarifications; Spec §CC-003; Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK007 Are optional validations clearly marked as optional rather than baseline gates, especially manual autocomplete verification and the intentional-breakage spot check? [Clarity, Spec §NG-004; Spec §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK008 Are exception words such as “highest-value regression paths” and “meaningful coverage” sufficiently clarified by surrounding acceptance scenarios and success criteria? [Ambiguity, Spec §Feature Summary; Spec §NG-002; Spec §Success Criteria]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK009 Do compatibility commitments, assumptions, and functional requirements agree on the same verification workflow artifacts and responsibilities? [Consistency, Spec §Compatibility Commitments; Spec §Assumptions; Spec §Functional Requirements]
- [ ] CHK010 Is the single-entrypoint runtime constraint (`extensions/index.ts` remains implementation truth) stated consistently wherever refactoring/testability is discussed? [Consistency, Spec §Feature Summary; Spec §Assumptions; Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK011 Do the automated-coverage requirements align consistently with the explicit exclusion of autocomplete from automated scope? [Consistency, Spec §Clarifications; Spec §NG-004; Spec §SC-003]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK012 Can each user story be accepted through a clearly defined independent validation path without depending on unstated reviewer judgment? [Measurability, Spec §User Scenarios & Testing]
- [ ] CHK013 Are success criteria specific enough to distinguish helper, discovery, and extension-flow regressions instead of allowing a vague “tests pass” interpretation? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001–SC-005]
- [ ] CHK014 Are acceptance scenarios written so a reviewer can tell what observable outcome matters for each flow (direct dispatch, selector flow, unknown subcommand, cancellation)? [Measurability, Spec §User Story 3; Spec §Edge Cases]

## Scenario & Edge-Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK015 Are primary, alternate, and exception flows covered across all three layers rather than concentrated only on happy-path scenarios? [Coverage, Spec §User Scenarios & Testing; Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK016 Are metadata edge cases (missing descriptions, malformed args, missing `_index.md`, wrong `_index.md` type) documented with enough specificity to drive tests without plan-time reinterpretation? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 2; Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK017 Is selector cancellation treated explicitly as a non-dispatch scenario rather than only as an implied edge case? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases; Spec §User Story 3]
- [ ] CHK018 Does the spec clearly identify which grouped-prompt behaviors are intentionally excluded from automated coverage and where manual verification still applies? [Coverage, Spec §Clarifications; Spec §NG-004]

## Non-Functional & Dependency Quality

- [ ] CHK019 Are performance expectations framed clearly as advisory guidance so reviewers cannot mistake them for release-gate requirements? [Clarity, Spec §Clarifications]
- [ ] CHK020 Are external dependency risks and fallback expectations documented for the harness-based Layer 3 approach? [Dependency, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK021 Are documentation-sync and validation obligations complete enough to satisfy the constitution’s “runtime workflow and documentation” requirement once tests are added? [Traceability, Spec §CC-003; Constitution §III]

## Notes

- Check items off as completed: `[x]`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Use this checklist to assess requirement quality, not implementation correctness
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
